_meta._note: Epoch AI internal eval scores (from https://epoch.ai/data/benchmarks.csv, 5542 rows). Per-(model, task) scores for the 7 ECI internal evaluations: Chess Puzzles, FrontierMath {Tiers 1-3, Tier 4} × {Private, Public}, GPQA Diamond, MATH Level 5, OTIS Mock AIME 2024-2025, SWE-Bench Verified, SimpleQA Verified. Scores are mean_score column, converted from decimal (0.479) to percentage (47.9). For models with multiple reasoning effort levels (low/medium/high/xhigh/max), best score per model is kept. 3 new benchmark registrations: chess_puzzles, frontiermath_tier4, otis_aime.

benchmarks.name: Chess Puzzles (Epoch internal)
benchmarks.description: Epoch AI internal eval — chess puzzle solving from a private test set. % puzzles solved correctly.

benchmarks.description: FrontierMath Tier 4 (private and public splits). Hardest tier of the FrontierMath benchmark — research-level mathematics problems.
